title: Steady Sets
shortDescription: Log sets, weights and reps. Track your workouts with a simple offline journal.
fullDescription:
Keep a clear record of every workout. Steady Sets is a simple workout journal that stores your training history on your phone.

• Log weights, reps and sets
• Keep equipment-specific records for barbells, dumbbells, machines and bodyweight exercises
• Browse workout history and track progress
• Copy previous workouts to prepare your next session
• Automatically select equipment based on your workout history
• Edit weights and reps directly in each set
• Rest timer with local notifications
• Add your own exercises
• Switch between kg and lb
• Export and import Markdown backups
• English and Korean support

No account or ads. Your workout records stay on your device and are not sent to a developer server. Export a backup in Settings before changing phones or deleting the app.

Notifications require your permission. Battery-saving and notification settings can affect when alerts arrive.

Steady Sets is a workout journal, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
releaseNotes: First Android release with workout logging, a rest timer, equipment-specific records, file backups, and English and Korean support.
